questions.question: What is the hole at the centre of the eye that lets light in?

questions.question: Which structures focus light onto the retina, and which layer is the cornea part of?
questions.note: PROPOSED. c02 gives cornea+lens focusing; c01 places the cornea in the fibrous tunic.

questions.question: What is in the anterior cavity of the eye and what fills it?
questions.note: PROPOSED. c06 names the contents and fluid; c04 describes the iris and ciliary body that sit in it.

questions.note: PROPOSED. Accommodation is not described in these passages. The lens is MENTIONED (c02, c06), which is what makes this a hard negative: retrieval will find something.

questions.note: PROPOSED. Pathology is absent; the retina is named repeatedly, so the scope terms will match.

questions.note: PROPOSED. Colour vision counts are not in the passages.

questions.question: What determines a person's eye colour genetically?
questions.note: PROPOSED. c04 says the iris is 'the colored part of the eye' — adjacent enough to tempt a fabricated answer, which is the point.

questions.note: PROPOSED. The sclera is named in c01 but never measured. A number here would be pure fabrication.
